body:
## Why

The Compare tab's lead route is now real — its travel time follows origin and destination (Seattle→Chicago 410 min, Boston→Chicago 300, Seattle→Reykjavik 643). The other two options are not. Varying-input probe, 2026-09-22 (`Code/Audits/trip-planner/2026-09-22-assets/evidence/probes.json`):

| determinant varied | lead min | alternative deltas | transfers |
|---|---|---|---|
| origin Seattle → Boston | 410 → 300 | **+45, +90 → +45, +90** | **0/1/2 → 0/1/2** |
| destination Chicago → Reykjavik | 410 → 643 | **+45, +90 → +45, +90** | **0/1/2 → 0/1/2** (no nonstop SEA–KEF exists) |

- `trip_planner/app/services/workspace.py:530-578` `_ensure_route_option_search_depth` pads every comparison to three options by cloning the lead with fixed `score_delta -0.08/-0.14`, `travel_minutes_delta 45/90`, `transfer_delta 1/2`, and (latent, once a scenario is priced) `estimated_total_delta 120/240`.
- `trip_planner/app/services/inventory.py:866-900` adds an activity **"Client priority planning block"** (120 min, 09:00–18:00, `anchor_worthy: True`) to **every business trip**. The traveller never enters it, yet it produces open questions on every card ("leaves under 90 minutes of schedule protection") and, for Reykjavik, marks the route "not recommended" because this meeting "cannot be reached inside its advertised start window".
- Feasibility reads "Ready to review" on every card for every trip.

## Scope

`workspace.py` route-option padding, `inventory.py` activity seeding, the Compare panels that render them.

## Non-Goals

- Do not replace the fixed offsets with different fixed offsets or a heuristic. An alternative appears only when the planner derived it from the trip; otherwise Compare shows one option and says why.
- No provider integration here (#1785, #1783).

## Tasks

- [ ] Delete `_ensure_route_option_search_depth` padding (`workspace.py:530-620`) and its callers; Compare renders only options the pipeline produced.
- [ ] Remove the seeded "Client priority planning block" activity (`inventory.py:866-900`); activities come only from traveller input or a source.
- [ ] Do not emit a transfer count the adapter did not measure (`transfers: None` → "Not measured").
- [ ] Show one option with an explanation when only one exists, instead of three near-identical cards.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Test gate** `tests/app/test_compare_truthfulness.py` drives `GET /api/workspace/{id}` for two trips differing only in origin and asserts that no scenario's `travel_minutes - lead.travel_minutes` equals the same constant for both trips unless the pipeline produced that option, and that no unresolved question or tradeoff mentions an activity the trip does not contain. **Deliberate break:** restore `_ensure_route_option_search_depth` — gate fails; revert passes.

## Reproduction

```bash
python3 Code/Audits/trip-planner/2026-09-22-assets/evidence/probe.py out.json   # uses the frontend payload (origin inside trip_frame)
# alternatives are lead+45 and lead+90 for every trip; "Client priority planning block" in every business trip
```
title: Compare pads every trip with fabricated alternatives and an invented business meeting
